newsitem.title: THAILAND: Sri Dhana temporarily suspends operation.
newsitem.headline: Sri Dhana temporarily suspends operation.

text.p: Thailand's Sri Dhana Finance Plc said on Monday the company had temporarily stopped operations following a fire on Sunday at the central Bangkok building which housed its new head office.

Sri Dhana Finance was scheduled to move into the new office at the President Tower in central Bangkok but the building was hit by a major blaze on Sunday, the company said in a filing to the Stock Exchange of Thailand.
The firm's operation were suspended to facilitate investigations into the fire, the company said.
Sri Dhana Finance is majority owned by the Srivikorn family, which owns the building that caught fire.
The company said all of its property in the new head office had been insured.
The SET on Monday suspended trade in shares of Sri Dhana Finance Plc on the company's request because of the fire.
